text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being programmed for every task. In supervised learning, a computer uses training data to learn. This data includes examples with correct answers, like emails marked as spam or not spam. The computer builds a model from these examples. Later, the model can make predictions about new data it has never seen before. For instance, it can guess if a new email is spam. The accuracy of these predictions depends on the quality and size of the training data. Good data helps the model learn better and make fewer mistakes.
